items.title: 'CitrixBleed 2' Wreaks Havoc as Zero-Day Bug
items.description: The same APT hammered critical bugs in Citrix NetScaler (CVE-2025-5777) and the Cisco Identity Service Engine (CVE-2025-20337) in a sign of growing adversary interest in identity and access management systems.

items.title: Google Looks to Dim 'Lighthouse' Phishing-as-a-Service Op
items.description: The phishing kit, run by a group known as the "Smishing Triad," has powered massive amounts of unpaid tolls and package tracking texts.

items.title: Google sues to dismantle Chinese phishing platform behind US toll scams
items.description: Google has filed a lawsuit to dismantle the "Lighthouse" phishing-as-a-service platform used by cybercriminals worldwide to steal credit card information through SMS phishing attacks impersonating the U.S. Postal Service and E-ZPass toll systems. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Exchange 'Under Imminent Threat,' Act Now
items.description: Threats against Microsoft Exchange continue to mount, but there are steps both organizations and Microsoft can take to limit them.
